project_summary.description: RepoPilot is an AI-powered developer workflow assistant designed to streamline project analysis and documentation.

modules.name: Scanner
modules.description: Recursively scans the project directory to analyze its structure and file types.

modules.name: Analyzer
modules.description: Analyzes the scanned files to count occurrences of various file types.

modules.name: Summarizer
modules.description: Generates a project summary based on the analysis, simulating AI insights.

modules.name: Report Generator
modules.description: Creates a JSON report of the analysis results and project summary.

usage_instructions.installation: To install RepoPilot, clone the repository and run `pip install -r requirements.txt`.
usage_instructions.usage: Run the CLI tool using `python main.py scan <target_directory>` to analyze a project.

demo.expected_output: A detailed analysis report will be generated in data/report.json.
